sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: The graph is not semantically faithful. Restrict the direct attachment rule to the lower end of the strengthened part of a main frame or intermediate ice frame, and model the conditional exception only for an intermediate frame whose termination is below the specified deck/tank plating, tank top, or ice stringer at or below the ice-belt lower limit. Bind that supporting structure and its class to the same termination; the current boolean flags on the frame and nested main-frame node do not establish this relationship.
